{#- "Recibo de Vencimento" / "Payslip" — Isoft Angola HR official salary receipt. A4 portrait, two copies back to back: page 1 ORIGINAL (for the employee), page 2 DUPLICADO - ARQUIVO EMPRESA (for the company file). Both copies print the same data. Each copy fills its page (.rv-page): content at the top, confirmation and footer at the bottom, so the receipt stays legible when HR prints two pages per sheet. LANGUAGE — every label goes through t(), i.e. _() with the receipt's own translation context, resolved while this template renders, so the receipt follows the language of the user who asked for it (frappe.local.lang). Names, NIF, social-security numbers, IBANs, codes and amounts are data and are never translated. FIGURES — every amount is copied from the Isoft Salary Slip by isoft_recibo_context (payroll/recibo.py). Nothing here calculates payroll. RENDERER — wkhtmltopdf (Qt WebKit): tables, pt units, no flexbox / grid. The stylesheet lives in the Print Format's CSS field (recibo_de_vencimento.css). -#} {%- set r = isoft_recibo_context(doc) -%} {%- set ctx = "Recibo de Vencimento" -%} {%- set cur = r.currency or "" -%} {%- macro t(msgid) -%}{{ _(msgid, context=ctx) }}{%- endmacro -%} {#- Amounts in the site's number format, no symbol: every amount column states the currency in its heading. -#} {%- macro money(v) -%}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(v or 0, 2) }}{%- endmacro -%} {#- Day / hour counters: "24" rather than "24,00", "24,5" kept as is. -#} {%- macro qty(v) -%}{%- set s = frappe.utils.fmt_money(v or 0, 2) -%}{{ s[:-3] if s[-2:] == "00" else s }}{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro d(v) -%}{% if v %}{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(v) }}{% else %}—{% endif %}{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro val(v) -%}{% if v %}{{ v }}{% else %}—{% endif %}{%- endmacro -%} {%- macro lines_table(title, rows, memos, total_label, total) -%}
{{ title }}
{%- for row in rows %} {%- endfor %} {#- Statistical components: printed for the record, excluded from every total. -#} {%- for row in memos %} {%- endfor %} {%- if not rows and not memos %} {%- endif %}
{{ t("Code") }} {{ t("Description") }} {{ t("Amount") }} ({{ cur }})
{{ row.code }} {{ row.label }}{% if row.hours %} ({{ qty(row.hours) }} h){% endif %} {{ money(row.amount) }}
